## Summary

**FMOVE** (Floating point convert and Move).

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `FPn → Dn` |
| Syntax | `FMOVE.s Dn,FPn`<br>`FMOVE.s FPn,Dn` |
| Description | Move in Double format from/to data-register. Move in Single format was always possible, now double (& extended) too. |
| FP condition codes | see table |

### FP condition codes

| N | Z | I | nan |
|---|---|---|---|
| * | * | * | * |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–6 | `1111001000` |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–14 | `01` |
| 2 | 13 | D |
| 2 | 12–10 | Src |
| 2 | 9–7 | fpn |
| 2 | 6–0 | Opmode |

- Mode=0=data register.
- Source Specifier 110=b 100=w 000=l 001=s 101=d 010=x
- Direction d=0: &lt;ea&gt;,fpn else fpn,&lt;ea&gt;
- &lt;ea&gt;,fpn : opmode = R000P00 where RP = Rounding Precision.
- 00=default 10=single 11=double.
- fpn,&lt;ea&gt; : opmode = zero (or k-factor for unsupported packed source-format)
- FSTOREI & FLOADI
- e-registers can be both float & data register.
- fmove.w e2,e3 can mean fp→d but also d→fp
- Vasm & asm1 uses fstorei for fp→d & floadi for d→fp in that case.
- Up to vasm 1.9f fmove defaults to fp→d. Force d→fp direction by using fdmove.

### Notes

- Apollo\_eXtended\_format layout is on fmovem page.
- Packed is not supported. (like 040 &060)

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have FMOVE. This page covers only the 68080 addition: double and extended format to and from data registers, and FSTOREI/FLOADI for E registers. For the classic forms, the Motorola manual applies.

## Do / Don't

- DO use FLOADI (D to FP) and FSTOREI (FP to D) when an E register is both operands, so the direction is unambiguous.
